notes: In-app community posting and per-slot credential verification. The console's Community view now writes instead of only reading: a composer starts a new GitHub Discussion (title, category, markdown body) and every row expands into its thread with a reply box, so the owner and the agent take part without leaving the product; the empty state carries the same in-app entry rather than only an external link. Both faces post through one shared channel, mycore/community.py, which owns a single dedicated credential slot (AIDOG_COMMUNITY_PAT, deliberately separate from the update-only AIDOG_GH_PAT), one 30-second write interval persisted so it spans the console and the chat service, and the 120/2000 character caps; the agent posts directly under an owner decision, bounded by exactly those limits. Failures stay a category word plus an upstream-safe detail - no token, no traceback, no URL with a query - and an unfilled or out-of-scope token is a designed state that the UI renders as the exact slot to set. New reads: GET /api/discussions/categories (the composer's category list, GraphQL) and GET /api/discussions/replies?number=N (one thread, anonymous REST, 60s cache, scrubbed hrefs); new writes: POST /api/discussions/create and /comment behind the Bearer gate, on the same 400/404/409/429/502 ladder. Every credential slot can now be checked where it lives: VERIFY on each row, VERIFY ALL on the card, two honest levels - a conservative shape rule for every slot and a real 5-second probe for the four a provider can prove (community token to the Discussions scope, GitHub token to /user, bot token to getMe, model key to the configured endpoint), with unset slots answering not_set instead of a failure and no value ever echoed. The agent gains a 26th registered tool, community_post (post/reply), always registered and honest about a missing slot. Verification: core 1607 to 1649, console smoke 234 to 283, source lint 0/69 with packs 795 to 847 keys per locale, ten probes green (onboard 33, inbound 17, mission card, mission board, alpha 19, gamma 35, delta1 41, delta2 51, delta3 42, delta4 73), the 17-leg real-machine E2E series green, frontend UI legs 62/62/20, site gates 62 + 59, screenshots 7/7, publish gate READY(0), and 34 capability documents with the new community_posting page.
